The '''Talcene system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located on the [[Perlemian Trade Route/Legends|Perlemian Trade Route]] within the [[Talcene sector/Legends|Talcene sector]] in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] Territories region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. This system contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Talcene]].
